en-US.name: Steady Noise Premium (Yearly)
en-US.summary: A year of pink and brown noise, rain, ocean waves, and a fan.
en-US.description: The yearly plan of Steady Noise Premium: pink and brown noise, rain, ocean waves, and a fan, all night or on a timer, with no ads. Costs less than half as much as twelve months of the monthly plan.

customProductPrompts.purchasePromptDescription: The yearly plan of Steady Noise Premium adds pink and brown noise, rain, ocean waves, and a fan for a full year.
customProductPrompts.boughtCardDescription: You now have a year of Steady Noise Premium: white, pink, and brown noise, rain, ocean waves, and a fan.

inSkillProductDefinition.testingInstructions: Say 'buy the yearly plan'. It unlocks pink and brown noise, rain, ocean waves, and a fan, the same as the monthly plan (premium).
